scope: Author and independent receipts; no scripted substantive verdicts
captureFormats: pdf original bytes with pdfPage locator
json original bytes with JSON pointer
text original full fetched response or fully documented original extracted content
original institutional image/deck scan with pixel locator and explicit visual observation
sourceRule: Primary institution/official rules/original research or creator originals; each claim must be supported. Translation and logical computation explicitly analyzed; not fabricated as source quote.
verdictRule: PASS requires human-like explicit substantive reading in both distinct roles and exact current facts. HOLD/FIX_REQUIRED not coverage. Mechanical validator checks identity/existence only.
imageRule: Save original bytes/hash; passage contains explicitly labeled visual observation (not fake textual quotation), locator specifies inspected object/region; actual image must have been viewed.
